title: Germany – Single-purpose sports facilities construction work – Sanierung Hallenbad Weikersheim_2.BA_Edelstahlschwimmbecken
description: Gewerk: Edelstahlschwimmbecken - Stahlbauarbeiten Die Stadt Weikersheim beabsichtigt die umfassende Sanierung des bestehenden Hallenbades, das baulich in den Schulkomplex des Gymnasiums integriert ist. Die Sanierung des Lehrschwimmbeckens erfolgt im Rahmen einer Gesamtmaßnahme in zwei Bauabschnitten. Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung ist die Erneuerung des bestehenden Lehrschwimmbeckens durch ein Edelstahlbecken einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Rohbau- und Anschlussarbeiten. Das bestehende, geflieste Betonbecken mit einer Größe von ca. 20,00 × 8,00 m wird vollständig zurückgebaut bzw. für die Aufnahme des neuen Edelstahlbeckens entsprechend vorbereitet. Das neue Becken ist einschließlich aller erforderlichen konstruktiven und technischen Anschlüsse fachgerecht herzustellen und zu montieren. Der ausgeschriebene Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere die Werk- und Montageplanung, Produktion, Lieferung und Endmontage des Edelstahlbeckens sowie die unmittelbar am Beckenkörper erforderlichen Rohbauarbeiten. Hierzu gehören unter anderem die Auffüllung der Technikebene im Bereich des Beckenbodens, Ortbetonarbeiten an den Bodeneinströmkanälen, Arbeiten an den Rinnenköpfen sowie die Ausbildung und Anpassung der Übergänge zwischen Boden- und Wandblechen. Die Leistungen sind im Bestand und unter Berücksichtigung der vorhandenen baulichen Gegebenheiten des Hallenbades auszuführen. Sämtliche für die vollständige, funktionsgerechte und fachgerechte Herstellung des neuen Edelstahlbeckens erforderlichen Neben- und Anschlussarbeiten sind Bestandteil der Leistung, soweit sie in den Vergabeunterlagen beschrieben sind. Die Ausführung der Komplettsanierung des Lehrschwimmbeckens ist für den Zeitraum von November 2026 bis August 2027 vorgesehen.

title: Germany – Construction work – 2026-0565 Zukunftsgarten Duisburg IGA 2027 - Teilprojekt Kultushafen - Los 5 - Gastronomie aus modularer Bauweise
description: Die IGA Metropole Ruhr 2027 (IGA 2027) ist ein regionales Dekadenprojekt und Laborraum für die nachhaltige Städte-Landschaft der Zukunft mit überregionaler Ausstrahlung, an der sich verschiedene Kommunen, Vereine und Initiativen beteiligen. Fünf Zukunftsgärten bilden die internationalen Schauräume der IGA 2027. Die IGA 2027 wird demnach die erste dezentrale Interna-tionale Gartenausstellung. Organisiert wird die Gartenausstellung von der IGA Metropole Ruhr 2027 gGmbH als Durchführungsgesellschaft, dem Regional-verband Ruhr als Regionalinstitution für die Metropole Ruhr sowie den Kommunen als Projektträger, u.a. der Stadt Duisburg. Die Stadt Duisburg repräsentiert mit dem Zukunftsgarten "RheinPark und Anbindung" einen der drei zentralen Hauptstandorte der Internationalen Gartenausstellung 2027 (IGA) und wird, in der Verbindung von Stadtentwicklung und grüner Infrastruktur, die Leitfrage "Wie wollen wir morgen leben?" beispielgebend, innovativ und ganz konkret beantworten: urban! Ausgangspunkt des Zukunftsgartens ist der RheinPark im Stadtteil Hochfeld, der auf ca. 33 ha Grün- und Freiflächen ein facettenreiches Freizeitangebot mit direkter Rheinnähe bietet. Der südliche Bereich des Zukunftsgartens ist durch den ehemaligen Industriehafen (Kultushafen) geprägt und soll im Rahmen der IGA 2027 zu einem erlebnisreichen Ort am Wasser umgebaut werden. Ziel ist es, die vorhandenen Grünstrukturen im Stadtraum aufzuwerten, zu ergänzen und somit den Anteil von Grün- und Freiräumen im Stadtteil, vor allem auf Basis der Nachhaltigkeit, zukunftsfähig zu steigern. Es handelt sich um eine geförderte Maßnahme. Die daraus resultierenden Nebenbestimmungen sind einzuhalten. Aufgrund des Beschlusses des Rates der Stadt Duisburg vom 12.06.2023 wurden darüber hinaus die Aufgaben der planerischen, baulichen, gestalterischen und inhaltlichen Bearbeitung und die Umsetzung der Maßnahmen IGA 2027 im Stadtgebiet von Duisburg durch den Beschluss des Rates der Stadt Duisburg vom 12.06.2023 (DS-Nr. 18-0877/15 v. 02.06.2023) auf die Wirtschaftsbetriebe Duisburg - Anstalt des öffentlichen Rechts (WBD-AöR) übertragen, die dieses Vergabeverfahren daher - soweit vergaberechtlich zulässig - im Namen und für Rechnung der Stadt Duisburg (im Folgenden Auftraggeberin oder AG) durchführt. Das Projekt wird in mehreren Bauabschnitten realisiert: 1. Ingenieurbau 2. Freianlage + Außenbeleuchtung 3. Gastronomie Die Bauleistungen werden in mehreren Losen vergeben, in denen jeweils zusammenhängende Werksleistungen gebündelt wurden. Es handet sich um folgende Lose: Los 1 Unterbau / Ingenieurbau Los 2 Oberbau / GaLaBau Los 3 Elektroinstallation + Lieferung Außenbeleuchtung Los 4 entfällt aufgrund von Zusammenfassung (Los 3 + 4) Los 5 Gastronomie Gegenstand des vorliegenden Vergabeverfahrens ist das Los 5 "Gastronomie".

title: Finland – Urban planning services – Tampere (Ranta-Tampella) - Nokia (Harjuniitty) lisäraiteet, ympäristövaikutusten arviointi ja ratatekninen suunnitelma sekä ratasuunnitelma välille Tampere (Lielahti) – Nokia (Harjuniitty)
description: Hankinta sisältää Tampere (Ranta-Tampella) – Nokia (Harjuniitty) rataosuuden lisäraiteiden ympäristövaikutusten arvioinnin ja yleissuunnitelmatasoisen ratateknisen suunnitelman laatimisen sekä Tampere (Lielahti) – Nokia (Harjuniitty) rataosuuden ratasuunnitelman laatimisen. Valtion ja Tampereen kaupunkiseudun välisessä MAL sopimuksessa vuosille 2024–2027 on sovittu Epilän ja Harjuniityn seisakkeiden suunnittelusta. Seisakkeet sijaitsevat hankealueella ja sisältyvät optiona suunnittelukokonaisuuteen. Lisäraiteesta on laadittu aluevaraussuunnitelma vuonna 2015 osana laajempaa kokonaisuutta Tampere-Lielahti-Nokia/Ylöjärvi. Vuonna 2020 valmistuneessa Tampere-Pori tarveselvityksessä on hanke esitetty kolmanneksi tärkeimmäksi kehittämistoimenpiteeksi etenkin, jos lähijunaliikenne seudulla kasvaa. Tärkeimmiksi tunnistetut kehittämistoimet on toteutettu rataosalla jo aiemmin. Tarveselvityksen jälkeen on rataosuudella lisätty ostoliikenteen lähijunavuoroja Nokialle. Tesoman seisake on valmistunut vuonna 2021 ja Nokian liikennepaikan kehittämistyöt vuonna 2025. Rauman seisakkeen rakennustyöt ovat käynnissä ja lisävuorot Raumalta Tampereelle on käynnistymässä vuonna 2027. Epilän seisakkeen esiselvitys valmistuu keväällä 2026. Harjuniityn seisakkeen esiselvitys on laadittu aiemmin kaavatyön yhteydessä. Tesoman seisakkeen vaiheittainen toteutus ja lisäraide on huomioitu seisakkeen lainvoimaisessa ratasuunnitelmassa (4.9.2020). Nokian liikennepaikan kehittämisen yhteydessä on selvitetty lisäraiteen sijoittuminen liikennepaikan kohdalla ja tältä osin aluevaraussuunnitelmaa on päivitetty vuonna 2021 julkaistussa liikennepaikan esiselvityksessä. Tampereen ja Nokian yleiskaavoissa lisäraidetarpeet on huomioitu kaavatyön yhteydessä. Asemakaavoissa lisäraidetarpeet on huomioitu varauksina niiltä osin, missä kaavamuutoksia on maankäytön kehittymisen seurauksena ollut tarve päivittää. Nokialla kuntarajalla, Kankaantakana ja Haavistossa on yhteensä n. 1 km hankealuetta asemakaavoittamatta. Palveluntuottajaksi valitaan yksi toimittaja. Hankinnan sisältö on määritelty tarkemmin tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa.

description: Booz Allen Hamilton Inc., McLean, Virginia (M95494-25-D-5001, P00005); Concurrent Technologies Corp., Johnstown, Pennsylvania (M95494-25-D-5002, P00005); and KPMG LLP, McLean, Virginia (M95494-25-D-5003, P00004), have been awarded modifications to previously awarded firm-fixed-price, cost-reimbursement, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, multiple-award contracts for professional support services in support of Marine Corps Installations Command Headquarters that will increase the shared maximum ordering value by a combined $96,718,238. These modifications bring the total aggregate ceiling to $198,145,615 and are executed pursuant to the attached Justification and Approval (J&A). This modification is necessary to address an unanticipated surge in high-priority, in-scope requirements driven by new Department of War (DoW) mandates, including the 2030 Barracks Initiative, enterprise-wide Facitlity Related Control Systems (FRCS) cybersecurity, and other needs identified in the Future Years Defense Program (FYDP). This action increases only the contract ceiling capacity and does not extend the current ordering period, which concludes on 5 November 2029, nor does it alter the scope of the base contracts. Statutory Authority: This action was executed on a basis of other than full and open competition (via a class Justification & Approval) pursuant to 10 U.S.C. � 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.103-1: Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. See attached J&A for more details.

title: Sole Source: Specialized Spectrum Analysis for National Weather Service
description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), Eastern Acquisition Division intends to negotiate and award a sole-source, firm-fixed-price contract to Niyam IT, Inc. under the authority of RFO 19.1306. The contemplated action is for a single, continuous, non-severable 12-month period of performance to conduct specialized spectrum baselining, physical site viability assessments, and line-of-sight radar relocation analyses across a prioritized list of Next Generation Radar (NEXRAD) facilities nationwide. Sole Source Justification: The sole-source determination is based on NOAA�s Sole Source Justification. Only one source is capable of providing the supplies or services required at the level of quality required because the supplies or services ordered are unique or highly specialized. Niyam IT, Inc. is the only known certified HUBZone concern possessing the integrated data architecture, proprietary geospatial analysis platforms, active security coordination, and specialized engineering capability to execute these requirements without introducing severe schedule delays or technical risk to National Weather Service weather forecasting operations. This pre-solicitation notice is not a request for competitive proposals and no solicitation package is available. title: Y--CA-KLAMATH BSN NWR-VC EXHIBITS
description: Notice of Intent to Sole Source The U.S. Department of the Interior, Joint Administrative Operations, on behalf of the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, intends to award a sole-source purchase order to Sea Reach Ltd., Sheridan, Oregon, for fabrication and installation of Phase 1 interpretive exhibits at the Tule Lake National Wildlife Refuge Visitor Center in Tulelake, California. The requirement includes final production preparation, fabrication, delivery, and installation of the Exterior Welcome and Orientation Exhibits and Interior Refuge History Exhibits, including English- and Spanish-language audio description, an interactive touchscreen, system testing, staff training, and project closeout materials. Sea Reach, under a competitively awarded contract, worked directly with refuge staff through multiple design revisions while the visitor center was under construction. Award to another vendor for only fabrication, final preparation, delivery, and installation would require substantial duplication of efforts and costs. The Government does not reasonably expect competition to produce meaningful savings sufficient to offset this duplicated effort. This acquisition is being conducted using simplified procedures under RFO Part 12. In accordance with RFO 12.102(a), the Contracting Officer has documented the determination that only one source is reasonably available. The Government intends to make award to Sea Reach Ltd. using simplified acquisition procedures. If no timely response demonstrates that another responsible source can meet the requirement, the Government anticipates award on or about September 19, 2026. Responsible sources may submit pricing and supporting capability information by 10:00 p.m. Central Time on September 19, 2026, to be considered by the Government. Submit responses to: Tanner Frank Contracting Officer U.S. Department of the Interior, Joint Administrative Operations Tanner_Frank@ios.doi.gov

title: Rees Scientific Environmental Monitoring Probes, Transmitters, and Installation
description: The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Clinical Center (CC), Office of Purchasing and Contracts, on behalf of the Department of Transfusion Medicine (DTM), intends to award a firm-fixed-price order on a sole-source basis to Rees Scientific, 1007 Whitehead Road Extension, Trenton, NJ 08638. The purpose of this acquisition is to procure and install environmental monitoring probes and transmitters for the Human Leukocyte Antigen (HLA) section within the NIH Clinical Center, Department of Transfusion Medicine. The equipment is required to correct environmental monitoring deficiencies identified during a recent Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) inspection and to ensure continued compliance with applicable regulatory requirements. The Department of Transfusion Medicine currently utilizes a proprietary Rees Scientific environmental monitoring system to monitor critical environmental conditions, including room temperature, humidity, refrigerators, and freezers. Rees Scientific is the sole-source provider of the compatible probes and transmitters required to expand the existing system. The required probes, transmitters, and associated installation must be fully compatible with the existing Rees Scientific proprietary environmental monitoring system. These instruments are used to monitor regulated laboratory spaces supporting patient care, blood product manufacturing, and clinical laboratory diagnostic activities. Proper environmental monitoring is essential to maintaining the safety, quality, and integrity of these operations. The Government has determined that Rees Scientific is uniquely qualified to provide the required proprietary equipment and installation. No other known source can provide equipment that meets the Government's requirements for compatibility with the existing proprietary Rees Scientific system. This notice is not a request for competitive quotations and no solicitation will be issued. However, all responsible sources that believe they can provide equipment and services meeting the Government's requirements may submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to satisfy the requirement. Capability statements must provide sufficient documentation demonstrating that the proposed products are fully compatible with the NIH Clinical Center's existing Rees Scientific environmental monitoring system and can satisfy all applicable technical and regulatory requirements. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether conducting a competitive procurement is in the best interest of the Government. A determination not to compete the proposed acquisition based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Responses shall reference Acquisition Number 26-007333 and include the respondent's business name, Unique Entity ID (UEI), point of contact, telephone number, email address, business size, and sufficient technical information demonstrating the firm's capability to meet the Government's requirement. Please email your capability statements only to shasheshe.goolsby@nih.gov by 6:30AM 09/20/2026.

title: Specialized Blood Products-AABB
description: The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Clinical Center (CC), Office of Purchasing and Contracts, on behalf of the Department of Transfusion Medicine (DTM), Transfusion Services Laboratory (TSL), intends to award a sole-source Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract to the National Blood Exchange (NBE), Association for the Advancement of Blood & Biotherapies (AABB) for the provision of specialized blood products, including rare blood types, required to support patient care within the NIH Clinical Center. The NIH Clinical Center is a 200-bed research hospital that provides care to patients participating in NIH research protocols. The Department of Transfusion Medicine requires specialized blood products for patients requiring transfusion therapy, including rare red blood cells (RBCs), platelets, and plasma products. The contractor shall be capable of providing specialized blood products, including leukoreduced red blood cells, AB plasma, cryoprecipitate, and single-donor platelets. The requirement includes rare, multiple-antigen-negative RBC products for sickle cell disease and other multiply transfused patients. Required blood products must be prepared in accordance with applicable Association for the Advancement of Blood and Biotherapies (AABB), College of American Pathologists (CAP), Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA), and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) requirements and must be screened and certified for human use. The contractor must also be capable of providing antigen-screened units for common and uncommon RBC antigens, including, but not limited to, C, E, K, k, Fy(a), Fy(b), S, s, Jk(a), Jk(b), V/VS, Go(a), Js(a), and U. The anticipated annual requirement includes approximately 300�400 antigen-negative leukoreduced red blood cells, 50�100 units of Fresh Frozen AB plasma, and 100�200 units of single-donor platelets, including HLA-typed platelets. The contractor must provide 24/7 accessibility, electronic ordering and tracking capabilities, and the ability to search for and distribute blood products from multiple blood centers throughout the United States. The Government intends to award this requirement on a sole-source basis because market research indicates that NBE is the only known organization capable of satisfying the Government's specialized requirements. NBE utilizes a nationwide network of FDA-licensed blood facilities with surplus blood components and provides access to a nationwide resource-sharing network. Through its affiliation with blood centers throughout the United States, NBE is uniquely positioned to locate and obtain rare blood products and respond to regional blood shortages and specialized patient requirements. The NIH Clinical Center is largely self-sufficient in maintaining its routine blood inventory; therefore, the Government does not require routine inventory from an outside blood supplier. NBE is utilized when rare blood products are required or when the available donor supply is insufficient, including circumstances involving Rh-negative donors and patients requiring rare antigen-negative products. The Government's market research identified no other known vendor with the capability to meet the complete requirement. The anticipated contract will be an IDIQ contract with a 12-month base period. Individual requirements will be ordered and funded through orders issued under the contract. This notice is not a request for competitive proposals or quotations. However, all responsible sources that believe they can satisfy the Government's requirements may submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to provide the required specialized blood products. Any capability statement must provide sufficient information demonstrating the respondent's ability to provide the full scope of the requirement, including access to multiple donor centers throughout the United States; rare and multiple-antigen-negative RBC products; HLA-typed single-donor platelets; FDA-licensed blood products; 24/7 customer support; electronic ordering and tracking capabilities; and the ability to locate and distribute specialized blood products from multiple blood centers nationwide. Information received in response to this notice will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether conducting a competitive procurement is in the best interest of the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed acquisition based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Interested parties shall submit their capability statements electronically to shasheshe.goolsby@nih.gov by September 20, 2026 at 09:00AM and must reference POTS 26-008618. Responses should include the company's legal business name, Unique Entity ID (UEI), CAGE Code, business size under NAICS 621991, point of contact information, and sufficient technical documentation demonstrating the firm's ability to meet the complete requirement. No telephone inquiries will be accepted.

If you would like to submit quotation, follow the instructions in Section 3 of the solicitation, complete the required portions of the attached document, and submit it to the address shown on the Standard Form 1449 that follows this letter. The U.S. Government intends to award a contract/purchase order to the responsible company submitting an acceptable offer at the lowest price. We intend to award a contract/purchase order based on initial quotations, without holding discussions, although we may hold discussions with companies in the competitive range if there is a need to do so. The Embassy intends to conduct a site visit and pre-quotation conference will held on September 08, 2026, at 10.30 a.m. Prospective offerors/quoters should contact djiboutiprocbids@state.gov and copy to kayadse@state.gov with the names of their attendees no later than September 06, 2026, at 14.00 p.m. to arrange entry to the building. Quotations submittals are due by September 20, 2026, at 16:30 p.m. No quotations will be accepted after this time. Proposals must be in English and incomplete proposals will not be accepted. Financial offer and technical offer should be submitted separately. Your quotation must be submitted electronically to djiboutiprocbids@state.gov and copy to kayadse@state.gov.It is important to make sure the submission is made in specific size and format; in MS-Word 2007/2010 or MS-Excel 2007/2010 or Adobe Acrobat (pdf) file format. The file size must not exceed 30MB. If the file size should exceed the 30MB, the submission must be made in separate files and attached to separate emails with less than 30MB each. Request For Information deadline is on September 09, 2026, at 14.00 p.m. and submitted to djiboutiprocbids@state.gov and copy to kayadse@state.gov. In order for a quotation to be considered, you must also complete and submit the following: 1. SF-1449 2. Section I, Pricing 3. Section 5 Representations and Certifications 4. Additional information as required in Section 3 5. Proof of SAM Registration Offerors shall be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) database at https://www.sam.gov prior to submittal of their offer/proposal as prescribed under FAR 4.1102. Failure to be registered at time of proposal submission may deem the offeror�s proposal to be considered non-responsible and no further consideration will be given. Therefore, offerors are highly encouraged to register immediately if they are interested in submitting a response to this requirement. Sincerely, David J. Hammond Contracting Officer

title: Radio Remote Units
description: 1. Notice of Intent The Air National Guard, 180th Fighter Wing, intends to award a firm-fixed-price purchase order on a sole-source basis to L3Harris Technologies, Inc. 2. Statutory Authority This action is being executed under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1) as implemented by FAR 13.106-1(b)(1): For purchases not exceeding the simplified acquisition threshold, contracting officers may solicit from one source if the contracting officer determines that the circumstances of the contract action deem only one source reasonably available. 3. Description of Requirement The Government requires proprietary equipment only sold by L3Harris for use with L3Harris equipment already in place. Due to security mandates, changes to configurations on command-and-control capabilities require secure communications from primary work stations while maintaining mandated distance from secret interent protocol router networks. The government is procuring remote heads that seamlessly integrate and interface with the unit's existing communications ecosystem currently installed at the operator consoles. 4. Rationale for Sole Source L3Harris equipment is already in place and integrated throughout workstations. Procuring remote heads from any other manufacturer would result in sever interoperability failures with the existing base station radios, necessitating a complete and cost-prohibitive overhaul of the Command Post's communications infrastructure. Consequently, L3Harris is the only responsible source reasonably available that can provide equipment capable of meeting the Government's minimum interoperability and TEMPEST and SIPR compliance requirements. 5. Notice to Interested Parties This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotes, proposals, or an invitation for bids. A formal competitive solicitation will not be issued. However, all responsible sources that believe they can meet this requirement may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. Any submission must explicitly demonstrate the vendor's ability to manufacture these remote units, including proof of capability to access and comply with the TEMPEST and SIPR requirements, and seamlessly integrate and interface with existing unit L3Harris equipment. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement for this or future requirements. Responses must demonstrate clear, convincing evidence that competition would be advantageous to the Government, would not hinder the mission objective, and that the alternative equipment is fully compatible with the existing L3Harris network architecture. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. 6. Submission Instructions All responses or capability statements must be submitted via email to 180.fw.contracting@us.af.mil no later than 10:00 AM EDT on 20 September 2026.

title: PACAREA Battle Watch Command Center Display System (CCDS)
description: The U.S. Coast Guard is soliciting for a Battle Watch Command Center Display System (CCDS) Integration for U.S. Coast Guard Pacific Area (PACAREA), Alameda, CA. detailed in the attached Statement of Work (SOW). This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 75150PR260000082 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ), for Battle Watch Command Center Display System (CCDS) Integration for U.S. Coast Guard Pacific Area (PACAREA), Alameda, CA. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. The size standard is $34 Million and NAICS is 541512. The contract type will be a firm fixed price purchase order. The Government proposes to solicit quotes for the following item(s): Battle Watch Command Center Display System (CCDS) Integration (See attached Statement of Work (SOW) for complete details). 1. Please read the entire solicitation, including all attachments, to ensure completion of all required representations, certifications, and submissions. Acknowledge all Solicitation amendments (SF-30) issued by the Government. 2. Your offer shall include ALL of the documents and information listed in the solicitation; and your offer shall be received by this office at or before September 20, 2026, 8:00 a.m., Pacific Time, to be eligible for award. 3. Submit your offer, with all required documentation to Contracting Specialist, Elizabeth Tam-Hurley at Elizabeth.h.tam-hurley@uscg.mil DO NOT CONTACT ANYONE LISTED IN THE SOW FOR ANY REASON. The POC to request a site visit is: Jacob Dupree, (510) 437-3701. 4. This solicitation does not obligate the Government to compensate for any costs incurred by the Offeror in preparation and/or submission of any offer, not does it obligate the Government to procure for said services/supplies. 5. Questions/Concerns: It shall be the obligation of the offeror to exercise due diligence to discover and to bring to the attention of the Government any ambiguities, inconsistencies, or concerns regarding the information in this solicitation. All question/concerns regarding this solicitation shall be submitted in writing (NO phone calls) to Contracting Specialist, Elizabeth Tam-Hurley at Elizabeth.h.tam-hurley@uscg.mil no later than September 14, 2026, 8:00 AM Pacific Time. Follow up/additional questions will not be accepted after this date. Offerors shall reference the solicitation number and provide enough information in their e-mail so the government can easily respond to their questions/concerns. All questions/concerns will be compiled and addressed on an "Amendment of Solicitation" (SF-30) and will be posted on the SAM.gov website for viewing by all potential offerors. *Only send questions/concerns to the Contracting Officer listed above. AWARD: The Government intends to award a contract to the responsible offeror whose proposal represents the best value, price and other factors considered. The Government reserves the right to accept other than the lowest-priced proposal if the superior technical submittals or past performance of a higher-priced offeror warrants the additional cost. Offers are due on September 20, 2026, 8:00 a.m. Offers must provide as a minimum: (1) solicitation number; (2) specifications being offered so that a determination can be made if item being offered meets the requirement (3) Total Proposed Amount (4) Point of contact name, telephone number and address, (5) Company UEI Number.

title: G002--NEW - Catholic Priest Services - 676
description: The Great Lakes Acquisition Center (GLAC) in Milwaukee, WI is searching for vendors who have the capability to provide Catholic Priest Services to Tomah VAMC, 500 E. Veterans Street Tomah, WI 54660-3105 as stated below, starting 03/01/2027. This is for Market Research purposes only. Chaplain duties will include but not be limited to the following: The contracted Catholic Priest shall be on the Tomah VAMC campus weekly to provide one Catholic Mass service for Catholic Veterans. While on site, the contracted Catholic Priest shall meet any identified Sacramental needs for Catholic Veterans to include, but not be limited to, Holy Communion, Reconciliation and Last Rites. COMPETENCIES AND QUALIFICATIONS OF CONTRACT PERSONNEL: A. Contractor shall be an Ordained Catholic Priest who possesses an ecclesiastical endorsement, from the official national endorsing authority of their faith group or denomination. The ecclesiastical endorsement is a written official statement, by the official national endorsing body of the faith group or denomination, certifying that the applicant is in good standing with the applicant's group or denomination; and stating that the individual is, in the opinion of the endorsing body, qualified to perform the full range of ministry required in the VA pluralistic setting. B. The Ordained Catholic Priest shall have the training of their religious faith group that is in keeping with their established standards. C. The contractor who performs the services covered by this contract shall be proficient in written and spoken English. D. Contractor shall have experience working within the VA hospital setting and/or other hospital settings.

title: APN CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT SERVICES FOR WAINWRIGHT BASE PROGRAM CFB WAINWRIGHT
description: Advance Procurement Notice Construction Management Services for: Wainwright Base Program CFB Wainwright, Alberta (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. This is an advance notice for a potential contract with anticipated security requirements to provide interested Contractors an opportunity to begin the sponsorship process for obtaining (if required) the anticipated security clearance(s). Note that there is no guarantee that this solicitation will proceed or that any security clearance(s) will be granted under the sponsorship process in a timely fashion or otherwise. This project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services The delivery method for this project will be Construction Management. This project will address infrastructure requirements to upgrade the Base Administration Area to meet the current and future needs of the Canadian Armed Forces at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Wainwright, Alberta. The intended scope of this work for this project should the project proceed will include: Building Infrastructure: Construction of new buildings to support accommodations, training, warehousing and administration requirements. Renewal of Existing Buildings: Upgrades to existing buildings to extend their lifespan and improve the existing conditions for users. Demolition: Demolition of existing buildings that have been deemed end of life that will be replaced with new infrastructure. Horizontal Asset Improvements: Modification and development of utilities, roads and parking lots in the support of new infrastructure. The estimated cost is in the order of $525,000,000. It is anticipated that this solicitation will be initated in July/August 2026. This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed by the Department of National Defence (DND). Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 86945; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants or contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant or contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has  met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal or a bid DCC will  send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Kara-Lea Lafosse Team Lead, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 780-842-1363 Ext.1501 Kara-Lea.Lafosse@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the bidder or proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated  sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. buyer: Department of Agriculture Food and the Marine
title: Ireland – Digital mapping services – An Area Monitoring System Service
description: The Department of Agriculture, Food and the Marine (DAFM) is issuing this tender competition to enter into a contract with a vendor to supply an Area Monitoring System (AMS) Service within DAFM which has the capacity to deliver the obligations of Article 70 of Regulation 2021/2116 which requires the continued delivery of an AMS service. Article 65 of 2021/2116 defines an area monitoring system as a procedure of regular and systematic observation, tracking and assessment of agricultural activities and practices on agricultural areas by Copernicus Sentinels satellite data or other data of at least equivalent value. It is the intent of this tender competition to solicit proposals from all interested vendors possessing expertise to provide an AMS solution to accommodate the needs of the Area Monitoring and Land Systems Division, within the guidelines established in the tender documents.

title: FORT RILEY - CHAPEL AUDIO VISUAL EQUIPMENT UPGRADE W911RX26QA076-0002
description: This requirement encompasses the commercial procurement, delivery, physical installation, and system-wide integration of upgraded Audio-Visual (AV) systems across Kapaun Chapel and St. Mary's Chapel at Fort Riley, Kansas. The scope of work requires furnishing and integrating two (2) brand-name Yamaha TF1 digital audio mixing consoles�specifically one (1) console for Kapaun Chapel and one (1) console for St. Mary's Chapel�along with one (1) companion Yamaha Tio1608-D/D2 Dante digital stage box at Kapaun Chapel under mandatory brand-name standardization, alongside commercial 'or equal' power amplifiers, digital wireless microphone systems, and existing sanctuary acoustic infrastructure, including the full integration of existing pianos at both chapels and two choir microphones at St. Mary's Chapel. In Kapaun Chapel, the contractor shall install a high-output solid-state laser projection system delivering a minimum of 9,000 ANSI lumens at native WUXGA (1920x1200) resolution with an operational lifespan of at least 20,000 maintenance-free hours, supported by Category-cable HDBaseT signal extension transmitting uncompressed 4K UHD video up to 330 feet (100 meters), a motorized tab-tensioned projection screen (minimum 126-inch height by 168-inch width viewable area) engineered to fit within the existing overhead finished wood valance, and a locking rolltop AV operator desk custom-matched to the existing footprint, natural wood finish, and platform location. At St. Mary's Chapel, the contractor shall install a simplified wall-mount control panel for non-technical user operation and pull new plenum-rated speaker wiring where required. Ancillary services include the safe de-installation and on-site staging of one government-owned Yamaha TF3 mixing console at St. Mary's Chapel for Government retention, the de-installation and disposal of obsolete peripheral playback equipment, and the routing of new plenum-rated, structured, and labeled cabling through existing conduits. Final contract closeout requires professional acoustic and video calibration, delivery of comprehensive as-built single-line schematics, complete handover of all uncompiled editable control programming files, configuration files, and administrative passwords to prevent proprietary lock-in, and a minimum of four hours of on-site operational user training for government personnel. A site visit will be held on 10 September 2026 @ 1400 hrs CDT at Kapaun Chapel, then at St. Mary's Chapel. Questions are due no later than 15 September 2026 @ 1000 hrs CDT. Any questions received after the deadline will not receive a response. The deadline has been extended to 18 September 2026 at 1200 hrs CDT. Please include a signed copy of the SF30 for W911RX26QA0760001 with quotes. On 15 September 2026, Amendment 0002 was issued to incorporate an updated Statement of Work (SOW), additional photographs and dimensions of the rolltop operator desk, the Government Question and Answer log, the site visit attendee roster, and U.S. Department of Labor Wage Determinations for Geary and Riley Counties, Kansas (governed by FAR 52.222-41). The deadline for quotation submission has been extended to 20 September 2026 at 1200 hrs (12:00 PM) CDT. title: Red Hat OpenShift Kubernetes Engine (OKE) and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Subscription Licensing and Deployment Support
description: The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Clinical Center (CC), Office of Purchasing and Contracts, intends to award a sole-source firm-fixed-price purchase order to Trilogy Innovations, Inc. for Red Hat OpenShift Kubernetes Engine (OKE) and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) software subscriptions and associated deployment support. The requirement includes 40 Core Band subscriptions of Red Hat OpenShift Kubernetes Engine, Premium, Confirmed Stateside Support (SKU MW01016) and six Physical or Virtual Nodes of Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server with Satellite, Premium (SKU RH00008). The subscriptions include Premium Confirmed Stateside Support and are transferable within NIH's internal infrastructure. In addition to the software subscriptions, Trilogy Innovations will provide up to 20 hours of expert-level engineering services to support the initial deployment and configuration of Red Hat OpenShift Kubernetes Engine within the NIH environment. Services include installation, initial configuration and system readiness, operationalization of the environment for NIH workloads, identification of technical gaps and requirements necessary to support PAS-X onboarding and production readiness, review of the NIH PAS-X OKE environment architecture, and knowledge transfer and configuration documentation, as required. This acquisition is required to support the NIH Clinical Center's transition from paper-based processes and the unsupported StemLab application to the PAS-X application. The current StemLab application has not been supported by its vendor since June 2022. The Clinical Center must comply with strict manufacturing, documentation, and reporting requirements, including requirements applicable to the manufacture and distribution of human cells, tissues, and cellular and tissue-based products. The Red Hat licenses and deployment support will provide the infrastructure necessary for implementation of PAS-X and support the transition from the existing paper-based environment to electronic recordkeeping. Without this acquisition, the program would continue to operate at risk and may be unable to satisfy applicable federal and state requirements. The Government intends to procure this requirement from Trilogy Innovations, Inc. on a sole-source basis. The program office contacted Red Hat regarding the requirement, and Red Hat directed the program office to Trilogy Innovations as the third-party reseller for this acquisition. Trilogy will provide the Red Hat software subscriptions as a pass-through from Carahsoft Technology Corporation/Red Hat, Inc. and will perform the required deployment support. This contract will be for one year. RESPONSE TO NOTICE This Notice of Intent is not a request for competitive quotations or proposals. However, all responsible sources that believe they can satisfy the Government's requirements may submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to provide the required Red Hat software subscriptions and deployment support. Interested parties must demonstrate their capability to provide the specified Red Hat OpenShift Kubernetes Engine and Red Hat Enterprise Linux subscriptions, including Premium Confirmed Stateside Support, as well as the required expert-level deployment and configuration services necessary to support NIH's PAS-X environment. Responses should include the company's legal business name, Unique Entity ID (UEI), CAGE Code, business size under NAICS 513210, point of contact, telephone number, email address, and sufficient technical documentation demonstrating the firm's ability to satisfy the complete requirement. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether conducting a competitive procurement is in the best interest of the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed acquisition based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Responses must be submitted electronically to shasheshe.goolsby@nih.gov by September 20,2026 at 2:00PMEST.

Authorized Commission personnel will obtain the data by direct online access. The data that the Commission requires for the inbound trades is gathered and tightly controlled by the U.S. Customs and Border Protection. The availability and accuracy of this data is a vital component to the investigative, monitoring and surveillance programs of the FMC's Bureau of Enforcement, Investigations, and Compliance (BEIC). The FMC does not have direct access to this data, so we have to rely on a subscription service that does have direct access. The data obtained from the subscription will significantly assist the Commission with the industry it regulates. This notice is not a request for competitive proposals.A solicitation will not be available for this requirement. The intent of this announcement is for informational purposes only. title: VUE 250-P Scanning Acoustic Microscope
description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS, AN INVITATION FOR BIDS, OR A REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS. FURTHER, IT DOES NOT REPRESENT A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT TO PAY FOR COSTS INCURRED IN PREPARATION AND SUBMISSION OF DATA OR ANY OTHER COSTS INCURRED IN RESPONSE TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. This is a Special Notice (PUR260183) with the intent to award a sole source purchase order to OKOS Solutions, LLC (OKOS), under the authority of FAR 13.106-1 based on their unique technical qualifications as the only known provider of the brand name �VUE 250-P Scanning Acoustic Microscope�. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) knows of no other sources for this requirement. Notice is provided as information to the marketplace, market research, and is an invitation for any other qualified companies to express their interest in and demonstrate their capability to provide the required instrument. The NTSB is an independent Federal agency with the primary missions of investigating civil aviation accidents in the United States and significant accidents in the other modes of transportation -- railroad, highway, marine, pipeline, and commercial space -- and issuing safety recommendations aimed at preventing future accidents. The NTSB has a requirement to accurately and effectively examine electronic evidence on accident components and systems often damaged by fire, impact, and water immersion. The Office of Research and Engineering (RE) Vehicle Recorder Division (RE-40) partially accomplishes this requirement using optical and X-ray imaging technologies at NTSB headquarters in Washington, D.C. To further enhance the examination of accident components, the NTSB intends to issue a sole source order to OKOS for one (1) VUE 250-P scanning acoustic microscope with accompanying computer including digital signal processing, 3-axis scanning software, and training to be located at the NTSB Vehicle Recorder Laboratory in Washington, D.C. The OKOS VUE 250-P is known to be the definitive tool used for non-destructive examination of semiconductor devices. Its ability to image silicon components without the mechanical removal of surrounding packaging material is a requirement for the Vehicle Recorder Division�s work. The division requires a device that has +/- 5.0-micro accuracy/repeatability, 0.5 micron data resolution, a scan envelope of at least 320mm x 136mm x 25mm, high pulse-echo transceivers, through-transmission, A-scan waveforms, B-scan cross section images, C-scan planar images, time of flight images, thickness images, a high sampling rate digitizer (8-bit, up to 4 GHz), and full 3D volumetric reconstruction. The only known device that meets NTSB�s requirement is the VUE 250-P scanning acoustic microscope. The only known source of this instrument is from OKOS. Sources capable of fully satisfying the above requirements are invited to submit capability statements/expressions of interest providing the government the necessary information to determine actual capability. At a minimum, this information, which must be prepared specifically in response to this notice should, must include: (1) identification of company or organization; (2) an assertion of existing, full capability to meet proposed requirements; (3) business/contracts/marketing office point(s) of contact; (4) notification of business size and /or special status; and (5) any additional information that may be useful to the successful procurement of the requirements, if solicited. These expressions of interest shall adhere to a five (5)-page submission limit plus web links and any specialized product descriptions. The statement of qualifications should include only information that clearly demonstrates the respondent's capabilities, expertise, and experience to provide the requirements described in this notice. General marketing material should not be included. The NTSB prefers that companies do not submit proprietary material. However, the government recognizes that proprietary data may be a part of your submittal. If so, clearly mark such restricted or proprietary data and present it as an addendum to the non-restricted/non-proprietary information. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. A determination by the government not to compete the proposed purchase order based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the government. All responsible sources may submit a capability statement, which shall be considered by NTSB. Parties must submit information within five (5) days of publication of this notice. NTSB will not return capability statements and the supporting documentation submitted in response to this notice. Telephone responses and inquiries will not be accepted. You may email questions regarding this notice to the issuing office to Bryan J. Moy via email at: bryan.moy@ntsb.gov.

title: Blood Coolers
description: SPECIAL NOTICE: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE A. General Notice Information Document Type: Special Notice (Notice of Intent to Sole Source) Procurement Title: Procurement of TacMed xFRIDGE� Expeditionary Medical Refrigeration Systems Notice ID / Solicitation Number: H9228126QE014 Contracting Activity: Special Operations Command South (SOCSOUTH), 29401 SW 125th Ave, Homestead, FL 33039 Classification Code (PSC): 6515 � Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment, and Supplies NAICS Code: 339112 � Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing Small Business Size Standard: 1,000 Employees Anticipated Award Date: 18 September 2026 Primary Point of Contact: Aisha Ross, aisha.j.ross.mil@socom.mil Secondary Point of Contact: Molly Miller, molly.l.miller.mil@socom.mil B. Description of Action and Proposed Contractor The Special Operations Command South (SOCSOUTH), located at Homestead Air Reserve Base, Florida, intends to award a sole-source, firm-fixed-price purchase order under solicitation number H9228126QE014 pursuant to the statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.302-1 (Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements), to TacMed Solutions, LLC, located at 1250 Harris Bridge Road, Anderson, SC 29621-1250 (CAGE Code: 3P1B8, UEI: WDK1HVNUA8J4). C. Description of Supplies and Operational Capabilities The proposed procurement encompasses ten (10) each of Contract Line Item Number (CLIN) 0001, xFRIDGE� Expeditionary Refrigerator System, Part Number 103979 (NSN: 4110-01-716-0048), with each system comprising the refrigeration unit with 25 liters of internal storage capacity, AC power cable, DC power cable, cable storage pouch, two BB-2590 rechargeable batteries, and operations manual, with direct delivery to SOCSOUTH, Homestead, FL 33039. The procurement also includes five (5) each of CLIN 0002, Spare High-Capacity Rechargeable Battery (BB-2590 HC), Part Number 102810, with direct delivery to SOCSOUTH, Homestead, FL 33039. Key salient characteristics require that the units provide a minimum of 25 liters of internal volume capable of maintaining tight temperature tolerances (1�C to 6�C) for whole blood and biological products, operate continuously on standard military BB-2590 batteries with integrated dual-battery management and on-board charging capability from external AC/DC power sources, and feature a ruggedized transportable Pelican-case form factor engineered for operational tactical environments and expeditionary field medicine. D. Statutory Authority, Technical Justification, and Fleet Standardization This action is conducted under the statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.302-1, which provides that full and open competition need not be provided for when the supplies or services required by the agency are available from only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. Regarding fleet standardization and inventory baseline, SOCSOUTH currently maintains, supports, and operates an existing fielded inventory of TacMed xFRIDGE� units across its operational components. Procuring matching TacMed xFRIDGE� units is necessary to ensure direct compatibility and interoperability with the command's existing cold-chain assets. Introducing an alternate or non-standard refrigeration model would break fleet commonality, create supply-chain inefficiencies, require duplicative spare parts inventories, and necessitate separate training pipelines and operational maintenance protocols for deployed medical personnel. Regarding airworthiness and flight safety integration, the TacMed xFRIDGE� system has demonstrated compliance with military flight safety standards, holding active Airworthiness Releases (AWR) from the U.S. Army Aviation and Missile Command and Flight Clearances from the Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) for operational use aboard designated military aircraft platforms, including CH-53, MH-53, C-130, and V-22. Utilizing equipment with established airworthiness approvals is critical to mission readiness and avoids flight safety hazards and costly testing delays. E. Submission of Capability Statements and Procedures This is a notice of intent and not a request for competitive proposals or quotations. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed action based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. All responsible sources may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. Submissions must provide clear and convincing documentation proving that the offered product meets all salient characteristics and agency operational constraints, including full physical, mechanical, operational, and logistical interchangeability with SOCSOUTH's existing fielded inventory of TacMed xFRIDGE� refrigeration equipment without requiring separate maintenance configurations, spare parts lines, or user re-training, as well as verified documentation of active military Airworthiness Releases (AWR) / NAVAIR Flight Clearances for operational use aboard the specified aircraft platforms. Any responses received will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether conducting a competitive procurement is in the best interest of the Government. F. Response Deadline and Points of Contact The deadline for response submission is 20 September 2026 at 16:00 Eastern Time. Interested parties must submit capability statements electronically via email with the subject line "Response to Notice of Intent H9228126QE014 - Expeditionary Refrigerators" to Primary Point of Contact Aisha Ross at aisha.j.ross.mil@socom.mil and Secondary Point of Contact Molly Miller at molly.l.miller.mil@socom.mil. Physical inquiries may be addressed to Special Operations Command South (SOCSOUTH), 29401 SW 125th Ave, Homestead, FL 33039.

title: Tampere (Ranta-Tampella) - Nokia (Harjuniitty) lisäraiteet, ympäristövaikutusten arviointi ja ratatekninen suunnitelma sekä ratasuunnitelma välille Tampere (Lielahti) – Nokia (Harjuniitty)
description: Tampere (Ranta-Tampella) - Nokia (Harjuniitty) lisäraiteet, ympäristövaikutusten arviointi ja ratatekninen suunnitelma sekä ratasuunnitelma välille Tampere (Lielahti) – Nokia (Harjuniitty) Hankinta sisältää Tampere (Ranta-Tampella) – Nokia (Harjuniitty) rataosuuden lisäraiteiden ympäristövaikutusten arvioinnin ja yleissuunnitelmatasoisen ratateknisen suunnitelman laatimisen sekä Tampere (Lielahti) – Nokia (Harjuniitty) rataosuuden ratasuunnitelman laatimisen. Valtion ja Tampereen kaupunkiseudun välisessä MAL sopimuksessa vuosille 2024–2027 on sovittu Epilän ja Harjuniityn seisakkeiden suunnittelusta. Seisakkeet sijaitsevat hankealueella ja sisältyvät optiona suunnittelukokonaisuuteen. Lisäraiteesta on laadittu aluevaraussuunnitelma vuonna 2015 osana laajempaa kokonaisuutta Tampere-Lielahti-Nokia/Ylöjärvi. Vuonna 2020 valmistuneessa Tampere-Pori tarveselvityksessä on hanke esitetty kolmanneksi tärkeimmäksi kehittämistoimenpiteeksi etenkin, jos lähijunaliikenne seudulla kasvaa. Tärkeimmiksi tunnistetut kehittämistoimet on toteutettu rataosalla jo aiemmin. Tarveselvityksen jälkeen on rataosuudella lisätty ostoliikenteen lähijunavuoroja Nokialle. Tesoman seisake on valmistunut vuonna 2021 ja Nokian liikennepaikan kehittämistyöt vuonna 2025. Rauman seisakkeen rakennustyöt ovat käynnissä ja lisävuorot Raumalta Tampereelle on käynnistymässä vuonna 2027. Epilän seisakkeen esiselvitys valmistuu keväällä 2026. Harjuniityn seisakkeen esiselvitys on laadittu aiemmin kaavatyön yhteydessä. Tesoman seisakkeen vaiheittainen toteutus ja lisäraide on huomioitu seisakkeen lainvoimaisessa ratasuunnitelmassa (4.9.2020). Nokian liikennepaikan kehittämisen yhteydessä on selvitetty lisäraiteen sijoittuminen liikennepaikan kohdalla ja tältä osin aluevaraussuunnitelmaa on päivitetty vuonna 2021 julkaistussa liikennepaikan esiselvityksessä. Tampereen ja Nokian yleiskaavoissa lisäraidetarpeet on huomioitu kaavatyön yhteydessä. Asemakaavoissa lisäraidetarpeet on huomioitu varauksina niiltä osin, missä kaavamuutoksia on maankäytön kehittymisen seurauksena ollut tarve päivittää. Nokialla kuntarajalla, Kankaantakana ja Haavistossa on yhteensä n. 1 km hankealuetta asemakaavoittamatta. Palveluntuottajaksi valitaan yksi toimittaja. Hankinnan sisältö on määritelty tarkemmin tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa.,

title: Kärrykartanon kiinteistöjen ulkoalueiden talvikunnossapito
description: Kiinteistö Oy Kärrykartano pyytää tarjoustanne Kurikan ja Jalasjärven alueilla sijaitsevien vuokratalojen ulkoalueiden talvikunnossapidosta. Hankinta on jaettu viiteen osaan: 1. Talvikunnossapito alue 1 (Kurikka A) 2. Talvikunnossapito alue 2 (Kurikka B) 3. Talvikunnossapito alue 3 (Panttila) 4. Talvikunnossapito alue 4 (Luopajärvi) 5. Talvikunnossapito alue 5 (Jalasjärvi) Tarjous voi koskea yhtä osaa tai useampia osia. Hankinta kattaa ainoastaan talviajan kunnossapidon: kulkureittien lumityöt (jalankulkuväylät/käsilumityöt) ja piha- ja paikoitusalueiden lumityöt loka-huhtikuussa. Hankinnan tulee täyttää Suomen lakien ja asetusten sekä viranomaisten antamat määräykset. Tarjous on sitova ja se tulee laatia suomen kielellä. Kaikki kilpailutuksen laskentamateriaali sekä tarjouksen jättölomakkeet on tallennettu tilaajalla käytössä olevaan Granlund Manager -järjestelmään. Päästäksesi käsiksi materiaaliin pyydä kilpailutukseen tarkoitetut käyttäjätunnukset järjestelmään seuraavasta sähköpostista: Patrik.Meling@granlund.fi. title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source - Law Manager
description: The Department of Justice (DOJ), Office of the Inspector General (OIG) intends to negotiate on a sole source basis with Mitratech Holdings Inc, utilizing an open market simplified acquisition procedure tool for a Firm Fixed-Price (FFP) contract. The purpose for this FFP contract is to establish a purchase order that will continue to provide the DOJ OIG the ability to access Law Manager Pro license with additional support and maintenance. The requirement supports maintaining and tracking all complaints and subsequent investigative activity. The NAICS code for this contract action is 541511 - Custom Computer Programming Services (SBA Size Standard: $34.0 Million). The Product Service Code for this action is 7A21 - IT and Telecom - Business Application Software (Perpetual License Software). Based on market research, DOJ OIG has deemed that the items for the requirement being sought will need to be procured through Mitratech Holdings Inc. The OIG currently utilizes a perpetual license of Law Manager Pro and receives maintenance and support through Mitratech Holdings Inc. It is in the best interest to procure with Mitratech Holdings Inc due to the currently utilized license being heavily customized by this vendor to develop the DOJ OIG�s Investigations Division (INV) sensitive case tracking database system (IDMS). No other vendor can offer support or upgrades to the software as it exists because only this vendor has access to the full programming code, as customized. Utilizing Mitratech Holdings Inc as a sole source offers the opportunity to procure the requirement without the OIG experiencing substantial duplication of cost related to customization, warranties, repairs, maintenance, etc. to new and existing requirements that could not be expected to be recovered through competition. It is recommended that the requirement be procured via a utilizing an open market sole source simplified acquisition procedure, utilizing authority found in FAR 13.106-1 (b)(1). This notice of intent is not a request for quotations. Any party who believes they can fulfil this requirement should provide a capabilities statement no later than Sunday, September 20, 2026 at 5:00 pm ET. The capabilities statement must provide clear and unambiguous evidence to substantiate the capability of the party to provide the requirement. A determination not to compete this proposed contract upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Verbal responses are not acceptable and will not be considered. When responding to this announcement, respondents should refer to Announcement 15G1AC26N00000004. If by Sunday, September 20, 2026, no viable responses have been received in response to this announcement, DOJ OIG shall negotiate solely with Mitratech Holdings Inc. Any prospective contractor must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) and be an authorized distributor of Mitratech Holdings Inc products in order to be eligible for award. Interested parties are encouraged to furnish information. All documents submitted will not be returned. All interested parties shall submit clear and convincing documentation demonstrating their capabilities to satisfy the requirements listed above to Contracting Officer, Johao Stewart by email at johao.stewart@usdoj.gov. The capability documentation should include general information and specific technical background describing in detail the prospective contractor's capabilities and experience that will demonstrate the ability to support these requirements, including proof of training and certification for performing service support for the Mitratech Holdings Inc manufactured/developed products and/or services, as well as an authorized distributor letter from Mitratech Holdings Inc should be submitted if you are not the manufacturer/developer.

title: $300M Indefinite Delivery / Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for Facilities Sustainment, Restoration, and Modernization (FSRM) Program at Joint Base Lewis-McChord (JBLM)
description: 1. NOTICE AND DISCLAIMER This is a Sources Sought Notice and Request for Information (RFI) issued solely for market research and acquisition planning purposes. It does not constitute a formal Solicitation, Request for Proposal (RFP), or Invitation for Bid (IFB). There are no bid packages, solicitations, specifications, or drawings available with this announcement. It does not constitute a procurement commitment by USACE, implied or otherwise. No contract will be awarded from this Sources Sought Notice. Participation in this RFI is strictly voluntary. No reimbursement will be made for any cost associated with providing information in response to this Sources Sought or any follow-up information requests. Submission of a response does not obligate the Government in any way and will not affect a firm's ability to submit a proposal if a solicitation is issued in the future. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the Governmentwide Point of Entry (GPE). It is the responsibility of potential contractors to monitor the GPE for additional information pertaining to this requirement. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to contractors regarding their submissions. Additional information may be requested after initial response, either from individual respondents or all respondents. 2. PURPOSE The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Seattle District, on behalf of Joint Base Lewis-McChord (JBLM), is conducting market research to support acquisition of an estimated $300M MATOC to support Facilities Sustainment, Restoration, and Modernization (FSRM) construction efforts. This Market Research will help USACE determine the availability and capabilities of firms working within this NAICS code. The responses to this Notice will also be used to help determine whether a small business or socio-economic set-aside may be suitable to apply to this potential procurement. 3. PROGRAM DESCRIPTION The purpose of this MATOC will be to support primarily general construction activities at JBLM and its sub-installations (Lewis Main, McChord Field, and Yakima Training Center), including but not limited to renovation, repairs, minor building expansions and pre-engineered buildings (not to exceed the statutory limit for new construction), preventative maintenance, environmental abatement, erosion control and earthwork. The JBLM FSRM Program includes operational facilities, training sites, administrative spaces, barracks/troop housing, utility infrastructure systems (HVAC, electrical, fire protection), and site work for JBLM Garrison facilities. Projects will span multiple facility types across JBLM. Task Orders under this MATOC are primarily intended to provide a timely procurement response to general construction work such as remediation of facilities, e.g., maintenance, repair, asbestos and lead-based paint abatement, and minor construction situations relating to but not limited to: civil, mechanical, plumbing, structural, electrical, heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC), and anti-terrorism and force protection. Projects will be primarily general construction activities including but not limited to renovation, repairs, building expansions, and pre-engineered buildings (not to exceed the statutory limit for new construction), or repair by replacement. Scope may also include preventative maintenance, environmental abatement (e.g., asbestos and lead-based paint abatement), erosion control, and earthwork. Construction situations may include but are not limited to civil, mechanical, plumbing, structural, electrical, heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC), fire protection systems, communications systems, and anti-terrorism and force protection. The MATOC may also be used for Task Orders expected to require some Incidental Design Work or extension of design effort by the Contractor, to include, but not be limited to fire alarm systems, fire sprinkler systems, HVAC system installation and balancing, communications systems, structural design of minor facilities or components and licensed professional engineer certification of site adaptation of pre-engineered structures. 4. POTENTIAL ACQUISITION STRATEGY The USACE Seattle District intends to award a MATOC to offerors determined to be qualified in accordance with the evaluation criteria. Aggregate Program Value: Approximately $300 Million ordering capacity, shared among all MATOC contractors. Structure: Qualified firms will be issued a MATOC contract, establishing a pool of multiple contractors available to support JBLM FSRM. Period of Performance: A 5-year base period with a single two (2) year option period. Exercise of options is at the Government's discretion. Project Size and Task Order Limits: The project size for Task Orders under this MATOC are anticipated to be between $250,000.00 and $25,000,000.00, and the average project duration is expected to be between six months to two years. Based on previous similar contracts, the occurrence of Task Orders may be frequent, especially in emergency situations, and during the 3rd and 4th quarters of the Government�s fiscal year. Project Delivery Methods: Projects will primarily be executed using Design-Bid-Build project delivery, with task orders representing the construction portion of project delivery. Task Order Selection: Competition for task orders will be held among all MATOC participants. Source selection methods will be determined for individual projects and may include various prices, performance, schedule or other trade-offs on the best-value spectrum. 5. ANTICIPATED INDUSTRY DAY USACE Seattle District anticipates hosting an Industry Day in the JBLM area on or about 15 October 2026. Exact date, time, location, registration instructions, and agenda will be published (SAM.gov and/or direct distribution to respondents to this RFI) later. Firms that respond to this RFI will be prioritized for Industry Day communications. 6. RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS Interested parties are requested to submit responses by completing the online questionnaire at: https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/k6LtDRMKPP The questionnaire is the Government's primary mechanism for obtaining detailed market research needed for determining the number and availability of contractors interested in this acquisition. Interested parties are also asked to submit a brief capabilities statement containing relevant information not otherwise addressed in the questionnaire. Capability statements shall not exceed 5 pages in length. Supplemental capability statements are requested to be submitted via email to the individual(s) listed below no later than 10:00 AM Pacific Time on 20 September 2026. Late responses may still be considered at the Government�s discretion but are not guaranteed review prior to strategy finalization. John McGuire, Contract Specialist Jeffrey Ross, Contracting Officer JBLM Special Projects Branch Contracting Division, Seattle District, Northwestern Division Email: john.e.mcguire@usace.army.mil Subject line: �Sources Sought Response � JBLM FSRM MATOC $300M � [Firm Name]� The Government welcomes candid industry feedback, recommendations, and other considerations that could improve successful execution of this program. Interested firms are encouraged to add themselves to the Interested Vendors List associated with this announcement on SAM.gov to receive future updates. Note: Do not submit proprietary trade secrets, protected technologies, or classified information in your response. All feedback received will be handled as public market research to shape the Government's final acquisition approach.

title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source - eCase Audit
description: The Department of Justice (DOJ), Office of the Inspector General (OIG), intends to negotiate on a sole source basis with CasePoint, LLC, utilizing an open market simplified acquisition procedure tool for a Firm Fixed-Price (FFP) contract. The purpose for this FFP contract is to establish a purchase order that will continue to provide the DOJ OIG with the ability to access eCase Audit licenses with additional support and maintenance. The requirement supports managing audits and document audit results. The NAICS code for this contract action is 513210 - Software Publishers (SBA Size Standard: $47.0 Million). The Product Service Code for this action is 7A21 IT and Telecom - Business Application Software (Perpetual License Software). Based on market research, DOJ OIG has deemed that the items for the requirement being sought will need to be procured through CasePoint, LLC. The OIG currently utilizes a perpetual license of eCase Audit and receives maintenance and support through CasePoint, LLC. It is in the best interest to procure with CasePoint, LLC due to DOJ OIG Audit�s organizational need of the currently utilized licenses. eCase Audit is proprietary software owned and controlled exclusively by CasePoint, LLC. No other source can independently license, deliver, or support it. Utilizing CasePoint, LLC as a sole source offers the opportunity to procure the requirement without the OIG experiencing substantial duplication of cost related to customization, warranties, repairs, maintenance, etc. to new and existing requirements that could not be expected to be recovered through competition. It is recommended that the requirement be procured via open market sole source simplified acquisition procedures, utilizing authority found in FAR 13.106-1 (b)(1). This notice of intent is not a request for quotations. Any party who believes they can fulfil this requirement should provide a capabilities statement no later than Sunday, September 20, 2026 at 5:00 pm ET. The capabilities statement must provide clear and unambiguous evidence to substantiate the capability of the party to provide the requirement. A determination not to compete this proposed contract upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Verbal responses are not acceptable and will not be considered. When responding to this announcement, respondents should refer to Announcement 15G1AC26N00000006. If by Sunday, September 20, 2026, no viable responses have been received in response to this announcement, DOJ OIG shall negotiate solely with CasePoint, LLC. Any prospective contractor must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) and be an authorized distributor of CasePoint, LLC products in order to be eligible for award. Interested parties are encouraged to furnish information. All documents submitted will not be returned. All interested parties shall submit clear and convincing documentation demonstrating their capabilities to satisfy the requirements listed above to Contracting Officer, Johao Stewart by email at johao.stewart@usdoj.gov. title: Switzerland – Transformer substation – Travaux de maçonnerie pour un poste électrique HT/MT
description: Le projet consiste en la construction du nouveau poste électrique Vaucens, situé sur la parcelle n° 3311 de la commune de Bulle, propriété de Gruyère Energie SA, à environ 250 m du poste électrique Etang existant. À terme, le nouveau poste remplacera intégralement le poste Etang. Le nouveau bâtiment sera destiné à accueillir notamment des installations haute et moyenne tension, comprenant un appareillage 72,5 kV exploité à 60 kV, un appareillage 24 kV exploité à 18 kV, deux transformateurs de puissance 64,2/21,5-18,7 kV de 31,5 MVA ainsi qu'une niche de réserve pour un troisième transformateur. Le bâtiment intégrera également les locaux et installations nécessaires aux services auxiliaires et au contrôle-commande du poste. Le présent marché concerne les travaux de maçonnerie nécessaires à la réalisation du nouveau poste électrique Vaucens. Les prestations comprennent notamment les travaux de gros œuvre et de maçonnerie liés à la construction du bâtiment et de ses infrastructures, conformément aux plans, prescriptions techniques et documents de l'appel d'offres. Les travaux devront tenir compte des contraintes particulières liées à la construction d'un poste électrique haute et moyenne tension ainsi que de la coordination avec les autres corps de métier et les fournisseurs des équipements électrotechniques.
